title: Hold a building services licence (certification)
what: Hold a building services licence of the relevant class before carrying out assessment or certification work.

sources.title: Occupational Licensing Act 2005 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person must not manage, carry out, or enter into a contract to manage or carry out, any building services work unless the person holds – (a) a building services licence of the occupation and class relevant to the building services work;

sources.title: Occupational Licensing (Building Services Work) Regulations 2016 (Tas)
sources.quote: 3. Assessment or certification work that is – (a) assessment and certification of architectural or engineering designs of proposed building work, or demolition work, including work performed for the purpose of obtaining statutory approvals, permits or authorisations to perform that building or demolition work;
